title: City
description: The city (D4, D14, D66): a square of cells, each given a district by where it lies. Every number (tune).

size.description: Cells along each side of the square.

arterialEvery.description: An arterial along every this many cells' edges.

core.description: Downtown: the cells within this many cells of the centre.

ring.description: Around it, out to this many cells.

band.description: Along the river: rows this wide, a few cells off the centre, crossing all but downtown.

strip.description: Along one arterial out of the ring to the city's edge, this many cells wide.

population.description: What the districts' densities must add up to (D4): a check, not a setting.
